record.final_answer:
The September 2026 total is **5437.50**.

The CSV has five rows, and adding them by hand gives the same number: 1250.00 + 380.50 + 2210.75 + 96.25 + 1500.00.

The script writes its result to `out/total-2026-09.txt`, but there was no `out/` folder, so it would have failed. I created the empty folder and left the script unchanged.
